# Subject scope. Clear all three wartime directive modifiers before applying a fresh role.
oe_van_v97_clear_war_directives = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_van_v97_mod_siege_focus }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_van_v97_mod_siege_focus
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_van_v97_mod_blockade_dir }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_van_v97_mod_blockade_dir
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_van_v97_mod_scorched_dir }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_van_v97_mod_scorched_dir
    }
}
